label: PF Backlog 414
title: PFSSOT build-time plug/unplug: exclude the worker subsystem from a build/edition (ship-without-workers)
body:
Folds into Epic A / A3 (PF platform build-package-deploy pipeline). Build-time plug/unplug: exclude the worker subsystem per edition (worker_integration=included|excluded) via build profiles. See docs/PF-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE-AND-IP-PLAN.md.

[update 2026-10-07] WONTFIX — premise invalidated by the ADR-0002 cut-over (WorkerGrid Stage 2b, BI-PF-0410): the in-PF worker subsystem (core/worker*.py, /api/v1/engineering/{workers,work,adapters,dispatch*}) was removed entirely, and scripts/dev/single_path_check.py fails if it reappears - so 'ship-without-workers' is now the default and only mode. config/worker-integration.json never existed in git (verified: no commit ever touched it). WorkerGrid is a separate component outside PF editions; see docs/WORKERGRID-DESIGN.md section 12.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/build_manager.py, core/build_utility.py, core/plugins.py, core/tier_builder.py

dashboard_impact.reason: no dashboard surface: build-time worker plug/unplug is moot after the ADR-0002 cut-over - PF ships with no worker subsystem (single_path gate); WorkerGrid is a separate component outside PF editions
